 Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Aditya Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the Petitioner.

2.  Mr. G.C. Joshi, learned AGA with Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand/1 & 2.
3.

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India filed by the Petitioner for quashing/setting-aside the FIR No.0396 of 2025, dated 22.11.2025, under Sections 120-B, 406, 420,
504 and 506 of IPC, at Police Station Nehru Colony, District Dehradun and directing the Respondent nos.1 & 2 not to arrest the Petitioner in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R.
4. Heard.

5. Admit.
6. Issue notice to the Respondent No.3. Steps to be taken within a week.
Counter affidavit, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.

In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the present Petitioner shall not be arrested by the Police in pursuance to FIR No.0396 of 2025, dated 22.11.2025, under Sections 120-B, 406, 420, 504 and 506 of IPC, at Police Station Nehru Colony, District Dehradun.

However, he will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present before the Investigating Officer, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of his statements.
9. Stay application (IA No.1/2025) stands disposed of.
